note: Point edits of the hippo body (README, "Point edits"). pnpm glb-point-edits assets/models/hippo/hippo-edits.json writes hippo.rig.glb from the file of the base commit, and pnpm studio-body hippo then writes src/models/studio/hippo.ts. The keys are vertex indices of the primitive fur, and the moves are in the stored space of the file (the bind).

groups.name: brow
groups.note: The two vertices on each side of the middle line between the brows move forward by 0.01 and 0.005 units, and the two inner brow vertices over each eye move back by 0.004 units. The middle line stood 0.012 to 0.016 units (1.9 cm to 2.6 cm) behind the inner brows, so the two inner slopes of the furrow shaded dark and the face read as a frown.
